summary: Enhance your business skills with our Zoho Suite training course. Learn to maximize productivity and streamline operations using Zoho's powerful tools.
lede: Zoho business software training helps business systems, sales operations, marketing, and finance professionals connect applications and automate cross-functional work. Learners configure CRM lead-to-cash workflows, link applications with Zoho Flow, and build reporting dashboards, while exploring financial operations, customer support, marketing journeys, data migration, and role-based access controls.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, and managing business software ecosystems. It serves those who must bridge the gap between technical configuration and strategic business outcomes.
modules: Zoho CRM Pipeline and Automation Design
Custom Process Digitization with Zoho Creator
prerequisites: Participants must have a foundational understanding of general business operations, including sales, finance, or customer support workflows. Prior experience navigating cloud-based software is required. No advanced programming or coding experience is necessary, though familiarity with basic logic structures (if/then statements) is highly beneficial for the automation and integration modules.
